sloka: पिता हि दैवतम् तात देवतानामपि स्मृतम् ।तस्माद्दैवतमित्येव करिष्यामि पितुर्वचः ॥२-३४-५२॥
transliteration: pitā hi daivatam tāta devatānāmapi smṛtam ।tasmāddaivatamityeva kariṣyāmi piturvacaḥ ॥2-34-52॥

translations.english: Father is divine even for the gods as cited in scriptures, therefore, looking upon father as my god, I will carry out his words, O father
